reason: I would not hand a property-sale sum to a company I have never heard of, however tidy the fees look. I would sooner sit down with the SBI NRI desk or my Canadian bank, even if it takes longer.
objection: Which bank actually holds my money, and is this regulated? The offer says a partner bank is named on the receipt, but it does not tell me which one before I start. I have no history with REPAIHUB, and a FINTRAC number does not tell me my lakhs are safe.
would_change_my_mind: Naming the partner AD Category-I bank up front, a big bank or a CA firm I already know vouching for it, and a first transfer of a small amount to test it.
